narrative: 站在离一个人只有一臂之遥的地方，14mm依然能把天花板、走廊，以及他们身后的街道都纳入画面。近处的体块膨胀变形。
远处的墙面向后退开。这个人物身处一个不会保持“规矩”的空间里，这也是为什么同一支镜头既可以让人感到亲密，又可以让人感到对抗性。
对于一个讨好的头肩镜头来说，这不是合适的工具。除非脸保持在靠近光轴的位置，否则边缘拉伸会把耳朵和脸颊变成卡通般的形状。
如果你只是想要一个身体加上一个可读的房间，而不需要这种英雄式的几何夸张，就退后一步，用24mm广角（24mm Wide）。如果墙面必须弯曲，那应该用鱼眼镜头（Fisheye），而不是直线校正的14mm。
how: 先确定站位，再选择镜头。把节点放在足够近的位置，让一只手、一张桌子，或者一张脸主导画面的尺度感，然后让14mm把其余的一切都纳入画面。
直线校正的14mm让线条比鱼眼镜头更笔直；剩下的拉伸感来自那个贴近的视点本身的透视关系。除非你有意要更多的拉伸效果，否则让脸远离画面的极端边缘。
建筑线条会从镜头轴心呈扇形展开。提示词：14mm ultra-wide on [Subject], exaggerated perspective, looming foreground, stretched architecture, slight heroic distortion.
when: 当观众必须置身于一个过大或过近的空间内部时使用它：一张脸出现在酒店大堂里，天花板依然占据主导地位。不要把14mm当作默认的人像镜头，也不要把它当作一个简单代表“宽”的标签来贴。
vs: 24mm广角是下一站：人加地方，却没有这么多的膨胀变形；鱼眼镜头则是有意让那些直线弯曲。
在同一个贴近站位上，50mm标准镜头依然会把房间信息裁掉；14mm则是“纳入”加“夸张”。强制透视（Forced Perspective）是一种沿着视轴方向的调度技巧；14mm则是贴近站位所形成的一种光学视野。
examples_film: 《荒野猎人》（The Revenant）常常在恶劣天气中贴得这么近拍摄，让身体和树木共享同一片充满侵略性的空间。《鸟人》（Birdman）在狭窄的室内空间里始终使用广角镜头，让房间始终不肯放过演员。
《堕落天使》（Fallen Angels）把脸拍摄在被拉宽的都市夜色前。《拉斯维加斯的恐惧与厌恶》（Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas）用贴近的广角制造主观视角上的不安感。
借鉴的是这种站位和视野，而不是照搬某一张画面。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是鱼眼镜头（弯曲的墙面），或者一个较远站位、却被误标为14mm的24mm广角。破绽要么是曲线式的弯曲，要么是一张平静的环境人像，没有任何逼近的前景。
解决办法：靠得更近，保持线条大致笔直，让近处的物体主导尺度感。广角镜头并不会在任何距离下都自动让脸变形；视点才是主导变量。

faq.a: 这是一支非常短的直线校正焦距镜头，从贴近的站位使用，视野极其宽广，近处的物体会远远压过远处的物体。是贴近的摄影机位置——而不仅仅是“14mm”这个标签本身——造成了这种夸张感。
贴近拍摄的14mm会让前景逼近突兀，房间急剧后退；24mm依然能保住人加地方的关系，但拉伸程度是中等的，脸只要不在正中心就能保持得比较好。如果这个节拍是报道式的、而不是侵入式的，就用24mm。
当一张脸或一个物体必须保持贴近、而周围的世界依然具有侵入感时使用它。跳过它，如果你要拍普通人像，或者其实想要鱼眼式的弧形畸变。

faq.q: How do I prompt 14mm ultra-wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：14mm ultra-wide on [Subject], exaggerated perspective, looming foreground, stretched architecture, slight heroic distortion。点名这个贴近的站位。除非你想要鱼眼效果，否则禁止桶形畸变。

narrative: Stand an arm's length from a person and a 14mm still holds the ceiling, the corridor, and the street behind them. Near masses swell.
Far walls drop away. The figure is inside a space that will not stay polite, which is why the same glass can feel intimate and confrontational at once.
It is the wrong tool for a flattering head-and-shoulders. Edge stretch cartoons ears and cheeks unless the face stays near the optical axis.
If you only wanted a body plus a readable room without heroic geometry, step back and use 24mm Wide. If the walls must bow, that is Fisheye, not a rectilinear 14mm.
how: Stand first, then choose glass. Park the nodal point close enough that a hand, a table, or a face owns scale, then let 14mm include the rest.

Rectilinear 14mm keeps straight lines straighter than a fisheye; remaining stretch is perspective from that close viewpoint. Keep faces off the extreme frame edges unless further stretching is intended.
Architecture will fan from the lens axis. Prompt: 14mm ultra-wide on [Subject], exaggerated perspective, looming foreground, stretched architecture, slight heroic distortion.
when: Use it when the audience must sit inside a space that is too big or too close: a face in a hotel lobby that still owns the ceiling. Do not use 14mm as a default portrait lens, or as a sticker that means wide.
vs: 24mm Wide is the next stop: person plus place without this much ballooning. Fisheye bends those straight lines on purpose.
50mm Normal from the same close stand still crops the room out; 14mm is inclusion plus exaggeration. Forced Perspective is a staging trick along the axis; 14mm is an optical field from a close stand.
examples_film: The Revenant often works this close in weather so bodies and trees share one aggressive space. Birdman keeps wide glass in tight interiors so rooms never let the actors go.
Fallen Angels films faces against expanded urban night. Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas uses close wide proximity as subjective unease.
Borrow the stand and the field, not a still.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Fisheye (bowed walls) or a distant 24mm Wide labeled 14mm. The tell is either curvilinear bowing or a calm environmental portrait with no looming foreground.
Fix: move close, keep lines mostly straight, let the near object own scale. Wide angle does not automatically distort a face from every distance; viewpoint is the dominant variable.

faq.a: It is a very short rectilinear focal length used from a close stand so the field is huge and near objects dwarf far ones. The close camera position, not the 14mm label alone, creates that exaggeration.

14mm from close makes foregrounds loom and rooms recede hard. 24mm still holds person plus place, but the stretch is moderate and faces survive better away from center. If the beat is reportage rather than intrusion, use 24mm.
Use it when a face or object must stay close while the surrounding world remains intrusive. Skip it for ordinary portraits, and skip it if you actually want fisheye bowing.

faq.q: How do I prompt 14mm ultra-wide for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: 14mm ultra-wide on [Subject], exaggerated perspective, looming foreground, stretched architecture, slight heroic distortion. Name the close stand. Forbid barrel distortion unless you want fisheye.
